Package com.sca4dj.build

Class Sca4djBuildMapping

java.lang.Object
com.sca4dj.build.Sca4djBuildMapping
public class Sca4djBuildMapping extends Object
声明当前 Gradle 项目参与的构建阶段、审计报告和最低质量级别。
